objective: 함수율·월의 기준 조건 환산 기록. Top3·승식·ROI를 평가하지 않는다.
source: Preserved quality-view source_rows.csv; complete normal results, all field sizes. No DB writes.
pair_population: Adjacent retained complete-normal races of same official horse ID and exact distance; both in same calendar year>=2017; 7<=gap_days<=90. Source observed starts remains observation count, not lifetime career. No finish-time truncation.
response: Later minus earlier raw finish time, in seconds. Horse-level fixed ability cancels by differencing; evolving ability not assumed constant.
model: Separate distance Huber IRLS ridge alpha1. Joint differences of moisture-band dummies (dry reference) and annual first/second sin/cos; nuisance: gap_days, later-minus-earlier carried weight, event age, age squared, log observed starts, field_n, race_number, grade and sex dummies. Train-only scaling, race-equal fitting weights by later race. No past-time covariate in primary pair model.
candidate_method: Train full joint model before each held year. For each of25 fixed moisture/month rate combinations scale those joint environment effects and refit nuisance coefficients on the same past training pairs. Compare later-minus-earlier observed time against nuisance change plus scaled environment difference.
latest_descriptive_fit: 2017 through2026-09-19, distinct from historical rolling fits; not used to score prior years.
primary_metric: Ending-race-equal mean absolute pair difference error(seconds). Secondary RMSE, band-changing vs same-band pairs, monthly residual disparity, raw corrected pair differences and condition support. These are observational consistency proxies, not true counterfactual error.
selection: Per distance choose lowest development MAE; among candidates within paired12-week-block oneSE of best choose minimum sum of rates, then lower moisture then month. Compare chosen vs zero with1000block resamples; if95%upper>=0 or RMSE worsens use zero as selected fallback. Freeze before confirmation.
confirmation_gate: 2024+25 MAE difference95%upper<0, each2024/2025 mean nonworse, and2026partial direction nonworse for provisional research reference. No operational adoption; if unmet retain fitted descriptive candidates labeled insufficient validation.
uncertainty: 1000 fixed-prediction paired12-week block resamples. Latest coefficients100 full model refit12-week-block bootstraps and100 horse cluster refits; rate fixed. Conditional on pair construction, model specification and selection; 12week blocks use endingdate, cross-boundary priorrace dependence remains.
sensitivity: Primary Huber; OLS ridge; pair gaps<=45 and<=60; modern2019+ training for rolling frozen selected rates. Preserve all results, no best-sensitivity selection.
support: Each moisture anddry>=40 unique endpoint races30 dates2years for display; month>=20 races15dates2years. Unsupported cells NULL. Reference dry0 is definition, not proven absence. Sum effect intervals from joint bootstrap, never add marginal endpoints.
artifacts: Code, plan, input hashes, all pair endpoint IDs/SHA, fold models and predictions, candidates, locked selection, confirmation/annual/condition diagnostics, latest moisture/month/joint reference tables and real-record examples with uncertainty, report, verification. DB and previous studies unchanged.
